operative_context: Reporting data must maintain traceability across financial outputs, activity views, and exported artifacts
conflicts_or_obsolete: Financial outputs do not currently align cleanly across all billing contexts and reporting representations
Exported reporting artifacts do not always match the same underlying interpretation used elsewhere in the platform
notes: TARGET R82b 'Reporting data lineage traceability' is addressed primarily through rent history and audit logging requirements (E2, E7) which establish that lifecycle events must be logged with timestamps and user identifiers, and that history records are immutable. However, multiple CONTEXT sources (E5, E6, E8, E9) consistently identify unresolved tensions between privacy-preserving audit design and operational traceability requirements, and between different data representations used in reporting, exports, and billing. These gaps prevent full operationalization of a coherent lineage traceability model. The PRIMARY evidence (E1) provides minimal direct support for the target and instead focuses on RBAC for approval workflows. Promotion of context rules is justified by consistent cross-evidence identification of the same traceability and audit logging patterns, but the conflicts and gaps indicate that the intended lineage model is not yet fully specified or implemented." Filtered abstract or low-relevance operative statements: System shall maintain full lifecycle history of rent records with timestamps and user identifiers for all events | System shall log all rent lifecycle events including creation, approval, rejection, activation, completion, cancellation, and modification | System shall ensure rent history records cannot be modified or deleted
